svg.title: House rules — how I build
svg.desc: House rules — how I build. 1. Ship early: Real users surface problems planning never will. 2. Observability is architecture: If you can’t see it in production, it isn’t done. 3. Pick the right tool: The trade-off matters more than familiarity. 4. Own the outcome: The deliverable is the running, monitored system — not the commit. 5. Communicate clearly: Async first, unprompted updates, no surprises. — Harsh, Vadodara, India.
